evaṃ cet sa bhikṣus taṃ tantravāyaṃ saṃjña(pya vā) saṃjñāpya vā tataḥ paścāt k(i)ṃcid eva mātram upasaṃhared piṇḍapātaṃ vā piṇḍapātamātraṃ vā piṇḍapātasaṃvaraṃ vā cīvarasyābhiniṣpattaye abhiniṣpanne cīvare niḥsargikā pātaya(nti)kā 24
children.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikā Pātayantikā</s> 24: If an unrelated householder or householder's wife is having a robe woven by a weaver for a [particular] <s>bhikṣu</s>, and that <s>bhikṣu</s>, without having been previously invited, should approach that weaver and, having adopted some alteration,

children.text:
PrMoSū_NP.25:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣoḥ pātraṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā dattvā tataḥ paścād abhiṣaktaḥ kupitaś caṇḍīkṛto 'nāptamanā ācchindyād ācchedayed vā ānaya bhikṣo cīvaraṃ na te bhūyo dadāmīti tena bhikṣuṇā sa vastuśeṣo niḥsṛṣṭavyo bhavati cāsya niḥsargikā pātayantikā 25
children.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikā Pātayantikā</s> 25: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having given a bowl or robe to [another] <s>bhikṣu</s>, afterwards offended, angry, and displeased, should snatch it back or cause it to be snatched back, [saying] 'Give back the robe, <s>bhikṣu</s>, I shall give [it] to you no more' — if that <s>bhikṣu</s>

children.text: PrMoSū_NP.26:

māsaśeṣe grīṣme bhikṣuṇā varṣāśāṭīcīvaraṃ paryeṣitavyaṃ yāvad ardhamāsakṛtāsu varṣāsu dhārayitavyaṃ / arvāk ced bhikṣur māsaśeṣād grīṣmād varṣāśāṭīcīvaraṃ paryeṣeta ūrdhvaṃ cārdhamāsakṛtāsu varṣāsu dhārayen niḥsargikā pātayantikā 26
children.translated_text: In the last month of summer, a <s>bhikṣu</s> should seek a rain-cloth robe (<s>varṣāśāṭī-cīvara</s>). It may be worn when half a month of the rains [retreat] has passed. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should seek a rain-cloth robe before the last month of summer, or should wear it before half a month of the rains has passed —
<s>Niḥsargikā Pātayantikā</s> 26:

children.text:
PrMoSū_NP.27:
daśāhānāgatāyāṃ pravāraṇāyāṃ bhikṣor utpadyetākālacīvaram ākāṃkṣatā tena bhikṣuṇā pratigṛhītavyaṃ pratigṛhya yāvac cīvarakālasamayā(n) nikṣiptavyaṃ tata uttaram upanikṣipen niḥsargikā pātaya(n)tikā 27
children.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikā Pātayantikā</s> 27: When the <s>Pravāraṇā</s> (invitation ceremony) is ten days away and an untimely robe becomes available to a <s>bhikṣu</s>, the <s>bhikṣu</s> who desires it may accept it. Having accepted it, he should store it until the proper robe-season. Should he store it beyond that — <s>Niḥsargikā Pātayantikā</s>.

children.text:
PrMoSū_NP.28:
trayomāsānāgate kārttike pūrṇamāse ūnavarṣāraṇyako bhikṣu(r) āraṇyakeṣu śayyāsaneṣūpagataḥ sy(ā)t sāśaṅkasaṃmateṣu sabhayasaṃmateṣu sapratibhayabhairavasaṃmateṣu
ākāṃkṣatāraṇyakena bhikṣuṇā trayāṇāṃ cīvarāṇām anyatamānyatamaṃ cīvaram antargṛhe upanikṣiptavyaṃ syād āraṇyakasya bhikṣos tathārūpapratyayo bahiḥsīmaṃ gantuṃ ṣaḍrātraparamam āraṇyakena bhikṣuṇā tataś cīvarād vipravastavyaṃ tata uttaraṃ vipravasen niḥsargikā pātayantikā 28
children.translated_text: 28. When three months before the full moon of <s>Kārttika</s>, a forest-dwelling <s>bhikṣu</s> who has not completed the rains-retreat should be at forest lodgings that are considered dangerous, feared, and terrifying — a forest-dwelling <s>bhikṣu</s> who so wishes may deposit any one of his three robes inside a village dwelling. If the forest-dwelling <s>bhikṣu</s> has such a reason to go outside the boundary, the forest-dwelling <s>bhikṣu</s> may be separated from that robe for at most six nights. An offense requiring forfeiture and confession.

children.text:
PrMoSū_NP.29:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānaṃ sāṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇatam ātman(aḥ) pariṇāmayen niḥsargikā pātayantikā 29
children.translated_text: 29. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly diverts to himself a gain that has accrued to the <s>Saṃgha</s> — an offense requiring forfeiture and confession.

children.text:
PrMoSū_NP.30:
yāni tāni bhagavatā glānānāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ sāṃpreyāṇi pratiṣevanīyāni bhaiṣajyāny anujñātāni tadyathā sarpis tailaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ saptāhaparamaṃ tāni glānena bhikṣuṇā saṃnidhikāraparibhogena paribhoktavyāni tata uttaraṃ paribhuñjīta niḥsargikā pātayantikā 30 //
children.translated_text: 30. Those medicines for sick <s>bhikṣu</s>s that have been authorized by the Blessed One as acceptable for use — namely, ghee, oil, honey, and molasses — may be kept and used by a sick <s>bhikṣu</s> for at most seven days. If one uses them beyond that — an offense requiring forfeiture and confession.

children.text:
uddiṣṭā mayāyuṣmantas triṃśan niḥsargikā(ḥ) pātayantikā dharmās tatrāham āyuṣmataḥ pṛcchāmi kaccit sthātra pariśuddhā dvir api trir api pṛcchāmi kaccit sthātra pariśuddhāḥ pariśuddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad
dhārayāmi // //
children.translated_text: I have recited, venerable ones, the thirty offenses requiring forfeiture and confession (<s>niḥsargikā pātayantikā</s>). Therein I ask the venerable ones: Are you pure in this matter? A second time and a third time I ask: Are you pure in this matter? The venerable ones are pure in this matter, since they are silent. Thus do I understand it.

children.text: V. pātayantikā dharmāḥ
children.translated_text: V. <s>Pātayantikā</s> offenses (offenses requiring confession)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.0:
ime punar āyuṣmanto navati pātayantikā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam āgacchanti /
children.translated_text: Now, venerable ones, these ninety <s>pātayantikā</s> offenses come up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s> every half-month.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.1:
saṃprajānamṛṣāvādāt pātayantikā 1
children.translated_text: 1. Deliberate lying — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.2:
apakarṣavādāt pātayantikā 2
children.translated_text: 2. Disparaging speech — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.3:
bhikṣupaiśunyāt pātayantikā 3
children.translated_text: 3. Slandering a <s>bhikṣu</s> — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.4:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānaṃ saṃghena yathādharmaṃ nikṣiptam adhikaraṇaṃ punaḥ karmaṇy utkoṭayet pātayantikā 4
children.translated_text: 4. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowing that a case has been properly settled by the <s>Saṃgha</s> according to the <s>Dharma</s>, should again bring it up for adjudication — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.5:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur mātṛgrāmasyottaraṃṣaṭpañcikayā vācā dharmaṃ deśayed anyatra vijñapuruṣāt pātayantikā 5
children.translated_text: 5. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should teach <s>Dharma</s> to a woman in more than five or six words, except in the presence of an intelligent man — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.6:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur anupasaṃpannena pudgalena sārdhaṃ padaśo dharmaṃ vācayet pātayantikā 6
children.translated_text: 6. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should teach <s>Dharma</s> word by word together with a person who is not fully ordained — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.7:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur anupasaṃpannasya pudgalasyottaraṃmanuṣyadharmam ārocayed bhūtaṃ pātayantikā 7
children.translated_text: 7. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should report a genuine superhuman attainment to a person who is not fully ordained — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.8:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣor jānaṃ duṣṭhūlām āpattim anupasaṃpannasya pudgalasyāntike ārocayed anyatra saṃghasaṃmatyā pā(ta)ya(n)tik(ā) 8
children.translated_text: 8. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowing of a serious offense of another <s>bhikṣu</s>, should report it to a person who is not fully ordained, except with the consent of the <s>Saṃgha</s> — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.9:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ pūrvaṃ samanujñako bhūtvā tataḥ paścād evaṃ vaded yathā saṃstutānām ime bhikṣavaḥ sāṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇāmayantīti pāta(yant)i(kā) 9
children.translated_text: 9. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, having previously given consent, should afterwards say: "These <s>bhikṣu</s>s divert the <s>Saṃgha</s>'s gain to their associates" — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.10:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ prātimokṣasūtroddiśyamāne evaṃ vadet kiṃ punar ebhiḥ kṣudrānukṣudraiḥ śikṣāpadair uddiṣṭair yāni bhikṣūṇāṃ kaukṛtyāya vilekhāya viheṭhāya saṃvartantīti śikṣāvidaṇḍanāt pātayantikā 10 //
children.translated_text: 10. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, while the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s> is being recited, should say: "What is the use of these minor and subsidiary training rules being recited, which only cause <s>bhikṣu</s>s remorse, vexation, and annoyance?" — for disparaging the training, a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.11:
bījagrāmabhūtagrāmapātanāt pā(ta)yantikā 11
children.translated_text: 11. Destroying seeds or living plants — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.12:
avadhyānakṣipaṇāt pātayantikā 12
children.translated_text: 12. Evasion and prevarication — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.13:
any(a)vādaviheṭhanāt pāta(yantikā) 13
children.translated_text: 13. Criticizing and annoying [another <s>bhikṣu</s>] with false charges — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.14:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sāṃghikaṃ śayyāsanaṃ pīṭhaṃ vā mañcaṃ vā brisiṃ vā kurcaṃ vā abhyavakāśe prajñapya tataḥ prakramen noddharen noddhārayed vā pātayantikā 14
children.translated_text: 14. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, having set out a <s>Saṃgha</s>'s bed, seat, bench, couch, cushion, or stool in the open, should then depart without putting it away or having it put away — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.15:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sāṃghike vihāre śayyāṃ saṃstīrya vā saṃstārayed vā tataḥ prakramen noddharen noddhārayed vā pātayantikā (1)5
PrMoSū_Pāt.16:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur abhiṣaktaḥ kupitaś caṇḍīkṛto 'nāptamanāḥ sāṃghikād vihārād bhikṣuṃ niṣkarṣen niṣkarṣayed vā cara pareṇa mohapuruṣa naśya tvaṃ na tvayeha vastavyam idam eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā nānyathāt pā(tayantikā) 16
children.translated_text:
15. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, having spread or caused to be spread bedding in a <s>Saṃgha</s>'s dwelling, should then depart without putting it away or having it put away — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.
16. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, angered, furious, wrathful, and displeased, should drag or cause to be dragged a <s>bhikṣu</s> out of a <s>Saṃgha</s>'s dwelling, [saying]: "Go away, you fool! Begone! You may not live here!" — using this alone as the reason and no other — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.17:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sāṃghike vihāre jānaṃ pūrvopagatāṃ bhikṣ(ū)ṃ paścād āgatyānupraskadya śayyāṃ kalpayed yasya saṃbādhaṃ bhaviṣyati sa prakramiṣyatīti idam eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā nānyathāt pātayantikā (1)7
children.translated_text: 17. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, in a <s>Saṃgha</s>'s dwelling, knowing that a <s>bhikṣu</s> arrived earlier, should come later and force himself in to prepare a bed, [thinking]: "Whoever finds it cramped will leave" — using this alone as the reason and no other — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.18:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sāṃghike vihāre uparivihāyasikuṭikāyām ahāryapādake pīṭhe vā mañce vā balena niṣīded vā nipadyed vā (pāta)yantikā
children.translated_text: 18. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, in a <s>Saṃgha</s>'s dwelling, on an upper-story hut with removable-footed beds or benches, should forcefully sit or lie down — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.19:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ saprāṇakenodakena tṛṇaṃ vā mṛttikaṃ vā siṃcet secayed vā pātayantikā
children.translated_text: 19. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should sprinkle or cause to be sprinkled grass or clay with water containing living beings — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.20:
mahallakaṃ bhikṣuṇā vihāraṃ kārayatā yāvad dvārakośārgaḍasthāpana ālokasaṃ(dhi)bhūmipari(karm)///...///nā dvau trayo vācchāda(na)pathāḥ saṃcaro///...///vyādhiṣṭhātavyā tata uttara(m) adhitiṣṭhet pātayantikā //
children.translated_text: 20. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a large dwelling built, up to the installation of the door-frame, bolt, and lock, the window openings and floor preparation... two or three roof-coverings... the passage... he should supervise [it himself]. If he supervises beyond that — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.21:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur asaṃmataḥ saṃghena bhikṣuṇīr avavadet (p)ā(tayantikā 21)
children.translated_text: 21. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, not authorized by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, should instruct <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>s — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.22:
saṃ(ma)to 'trāpi bhi(kṣur) yāvat sūryāstaṃgamanakālasamayād bhikṣuṇīr avav(adet pā)tayantikā (2)2
children.translated_text: 22. Even an authorized <s>bhikṣu</s>, if he instructs <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>s after sunset — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.23:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur evaṃ (va)ded āmiṣahetor bhikṣ(avo bhikṣuṇīr avavad)antīti pā(tayantikā 2)3
children.translated_text: 23. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should say: "The <s>bhikṣu</s>s instruct the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>s for the sake of material gain" — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.24:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣuṇyā sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya samānamārgaṃ pratipadyetāntato grāmāntaram api anyatra samayāt pātayantikā (tatrā)yaṃ sama(yaḥ) sār(thagamanīyo mārgo bhavati sāśaṅkasaṃ)mataḥ sabhayasaṃmataḥ sapratibhayabhairavasaṃmato 'yaṃ tatra samayaḥ (2)4
children.translated_text: 24. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, having arranged with a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, should travel together on the same road, even to the next village, except at the appropriate time — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense. The appropriate time here is: when the road requires traveling in a caravan, when it is considered dangerous, feared, and terrifying — this is the appropriate time.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.25:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣu(ṇyā sārdhaṃ saṃvidhā)yaikanāvam abhiruhed ū(r)dhvag(āminīṃ vādhogāmi)nīṃ vānyatra tīryakpārasaṃtaraṇāt pātayantikā (2)5
children.translated_text: 25. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, having arranged with a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, should board a boat, whether going upstream or downstream, except for crossing [a river] — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.26:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur ajñātyā bhikṣuṇyāś cīvaraṃ kuryāt pātayantikā (26)
children.translated_text: 26. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should make a robe for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is not a relative — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.27:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur ajñātyā bhikṣuṇyāś cīvaraṃ dadyāt pātayantikā (2)7
children.translated_text: 27. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should give a robe to a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is not a relative — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.28:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣuṇyā sārdham ekākī rahasi praticchanne niṣadyāṃ kalpayet pātayantikā (2)8
children.translated_text: 28. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should sit alone in private with a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> in a secluded place — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.29:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur ekā(kī) mātṛgrāmeṇa sārdham abhyavakāśe niṣadyāṃ kalpayet pātayantikā (2)9
children.translated_text: 29. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should sit alone with a woman in an open place — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.30:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣuṇīparipācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuṃjītānyatra prāg(g)ṛhisamārambhāt pātayantikā 30 //
children.translated_text: 30. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should eat alms-food prepared by a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, except when invited to a meal beforehand — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.31:
paraṃparabhojanam anyatra samayāt pātayantikā tatrāyaṃ samayo glānasamayaś cīvaradānakālasamayo 'yaṃ tatra samayaḥ 31
children.translated_text: 31. Eating in succession [at different houses] except at the appropriate time — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense. The appropriate time here is: the time of illness and the time of robe-giving — this is the appropriate time.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.32:
ekāvasathoṣitena bhikṣuṇā aglānenaikaḥ piṇḍapāta(ḥ) paribhoktavyas tata uttaraṃ paribhuṃjīta pā(tayantikā 32)
children.translated_text: 32. A <s>bhikṣu</s> staying at a single lodging, if not sick, should eat only one alms-meal. If he eats more — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text: PrMoSū_Pāt.33:

(bhikṣa)vaḥ punaḥ saṃbahulāḥ kulāny upasaṃkrameyus tāṃś cec chrāddhā b(r)āhmaṇagṛ(ha)patay(o yāva)darthaṃ pravārayeyuḥ pūpair vā manthair vā ākāṃkṣamāṇais tair bhikṣubhi(r) dv(au) trayo (vā) pātrapūrāḥ pratigṛhīta(vy)ās tata uttaraṃ pratigṛhṇīyuḥ pātayantikā / dvau trīṃ vā pātrapūrāṃ pratigṛhya bahi(r ārā)maṃ (n)iṣk(r)amya santo bhikṣavaḥ saṃvedayitavyā iyaṃ tatra sāmīciḥ 33
children.translated_text: If several <s>bhikṣu</s>s should visit families, and if faithful <s>brāhmaṇa</s>-householders should invite them to as much as they wish — cakes, barley-gruel, and the like — those <s>bhikṣu</s>s who wish [more] should accept at most two or three bowlfuls. If they accept more — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense. Having accepted two or three bowlfuls, they should go outside the monastery and inform the <s>bhikṣu</s>s present. This is the proper procedure here.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.34:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhuktavāṃ pravāritaḥ akṛtā(t)iriktaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ khāded vā bhuṃjīta vā pātayantikā 34
children.translated_text: 34. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, having eaten and been invited [to stop], should chew or eat food that is not leftover [from a formal invitation] — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.35:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānaṃ bhikṣuṃ bhuktavantaṃ pravāritam akṛt(āt)iriktena khādanīyabhojanīyena yāvadarthaṃ pravārayed idam āyuṣmaṃ khādeti bhuṃkṣvety āsādanaprekṣī kaccid eṣa bhikṣur muhūrtam apy āsāditaḥ syād idam eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā nānyathā pātayantikā 35
children.translated_text: 35. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowing that a <s>bhikṣu</s> has eaten and been invited [to stop], should invite him to eat non-leftover food to his fill, [saying]: "Venerable one, chew this, eat this" — looking for an opportunity to find fault, [thinking]: "Might this <s>bhikṣu</s> be caught for even a moment?" — using this alone as the reason and no other — a <s>pātayantikā</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.36:
gaṇabhojanam anyatra samayāt pātayantikā tatrāyaṃ samayo glānasamayaś cīvaradānakālasamayaḥ adhvānamārgasamayaḥ nāvādhirohaṇaṃ mahāsamājaśramaṇabhaktasamayo 'yaṃ tatra samayaḥ (3)6
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.36:
Group eating, except at a proper occasion — <s>pātayantikā</s> (offense requiring expiation). Herein, these are the proper occasions: the occasion of illness, the occasion of the time for giving robes, the occasion of traveling on a road, the occasion of boarding a boat, and the occasion of a great assembly where food is offered to ascetics. These are the proper occasions. 36

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.37:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur akāle khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ khāded vā bhuṃjīta vā pātaya(n)tikā 37
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.37:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> eats or consumes hard or soft food at an improper time — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 37

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.38:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ saṃnihitaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ khāded vā bhuṃjīta vā pātayantikā 38
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.38:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> eats or consumes stored hard or soft food — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 38

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.39:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur aparigṛhītam āhāraṃ mukhadvāreṇāhared anyatrodakadantakāṣṭhābhyāṃ pātayantikā 39
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.39:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> conveys to his mouth food that has not been formally received, other than water and tooth-cleaning sticks — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 39

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.40:
yāni punas tāni kuleṣu praṇītabhojanāny anujñātāni tadyathā kṣīraṃ dadhi navanītaṃ sarpis tailaṃ matsyo māṃsavallūrā yaḥ punar bhikṣur evaṃrūpāṇi praṇītabhojanāny ātmārtham aglāno vijñapayet pātayantikā 40 //
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.40:
Now, the choice foods permitted in families are as follows: milk, curds, fresh butter, ghee, oil, fish, meat, and dried meat. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, while not ill, should request such choice foods for his own sake — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 40

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.41:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānaṃ saprāṇakam udakaṃ paribhuṃjīta pātayantikā 41
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.41:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> knowingly uses water containing living beings — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 41

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.42:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sabhojane kule anupraskadya āsane niṣadyāṃ kalpayet pātayantikā 42
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.42:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having intruded upon a family where food is being served, should settle himself upon a seat — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 42

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.43:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sabhojane kule ekākī ekayā rahasi praticchanne niṣadyāṃ kalpayet pātayantikā 43
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.43:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, alone with a single woman, in a secluded, concealed place, should settle himself upon a seat in a family where food is being served — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 43

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.44:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur acelakasya parivrājakasya vā parivrājikāyā vā svahastaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ dadyāt pātayantikā 44
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.44:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> gives hard or soft food with his own hand to a naked ascetic (<s>acelaka</s>), a male wanderer (<s>parivrājaka</s>), or a female wanderer (<s>parivrājikā</s>) — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 44

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.45:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur udyuktāṃ senāṃ darśanāyopasaṃkramed anyatras tathārūpapratyayāt pātayantikā 45
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.45:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> approaches a deployed army to watch it, except for a proper reason — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 45

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.46:
syād bhikṣos tathārūpapratyayo yenodyuktāṃ senāṃ gacched dvirātraparamaṃ tena bhikṣuṇā tatra senāyāṃ vastavyaṃ tata uttaraṃ vaset pātayantikā 46
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.46:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> has a proper reason to go to a deployed army, that <s>bhikṣu</s> may stay with that army for at most two nights. If he stays longer than that — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 46

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.47:
dvirātraparamaṃ ced bhikṣuḥ senāyāṃ vasaty udyūthikāṃ senāṃ darśanāyopasaṃkramed dhvajāgraṃ vā balāgraṃ vā senāvyūhaṃ vā anīkadarśanaṃ vā pātayantikā 47
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.47:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, staying with an army for at most two nights, approaches a deployed army to watch the banner-front, the battle-front, the army formation, or the troop review — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 47

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.48:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur abhiṣaktaḥ kupitaś caṇḍībhūto 'nāpta(ma)nā bhikṣoḥ prahāraṃ dadyāt pāta(yantikā) 48
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.48:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, provoked, angry, enraged, and displeased, strikes a <s>bhikṣu</s> — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 48

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.49:
(yaḥ puna)r bhikṣur abhiṣaktaḥ kupitaś caṇḍībhūto 'nāptamanā bhikṣos talaśaktikayā prahāram avaguret pātayantikā (49)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.49:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, provoked, angry, enraged, and displeased, threatens a <s>bhikṣu</s> with a blow of the palm or a weapon — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 49

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.50:
(yaḥ) punar bhikṣur bhikṣor j(ā)naṃ duṣṭhūlāpatti(ṃ) praticchādayed antata ekarātram api pā(tayantikā) 50
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.50:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> knowingly conceals a grave offense (<s>duṣṭhūlāpatti</s>) of a <s>bhikṣu</s>, even for a single night — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 50

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.51:
ya(ḥ pu)nar bhikṣur bhikṣum evaṃ vaded ehy āyuṣmaṃ kulāny upasaṃkramiṣyāvas tatra te dāpayiṣyāmi praṇītaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ sa tasya bhikṣor adāpayitvā tataḥ paścād evaṃ vaded gaccha tvam āyuṣman na me tvayā sārdhaṃ phāṣa(ṃ) kathā vā niṣadyā vā ekākino me phāṣaṃ kathā vā niṣadyā vā udyojanaprekṣī kaccid eṣa bhikṣur muhūrtam apy udyojitaḥ syād etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā nānyathā pātayantikā (5)1
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.51:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> says to a <s>bhikṣu</s>: 'Come, venerable one, let us visit families; there I will have choice hard and soft food given to you' — and then, not having it given to that <s>bhikṣu</s>, he says afterwards: 'Go, venerable one, for conversation or sitting with you is not pleasant for me; conversation or sitting alone is pleasant for me' — [doing so] with the intention of getting rid of [the other monk], [thinking] 'Might this <s>bhikṣu</s> be gotten rid of even for a moment' — making this the sole motive and no other — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 51

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.52:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur aglāno vitapanaprekṣī abhyavakāśe jyotiḥ samindhyāt samedhayed vānyatra pratyayāt pātayantikā (5)2
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.52:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, while not ill, with the intent of warming himself, lights or causes to be lit a fire in the open, except for a proper reason — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 52

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.53:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur anupasaṃpannena pudgalena sārdham uttaraṃdvirātraṃ sahāgāraśayyāṃ kalpayet pātayantikā (5)3
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.53:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> shares a sleeping place in the same room with a person who has not received full ordination (<s>anupasaṃpanna</s>) for more than two nights — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 53

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.54:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur dhārmike saṃghakaraṇīye cchandaṃ dat(t)vā tataḥ paścāt kṣepadharmam āpadyeta pātayantikā (5)4
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.54:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having given his consent in a lawful proceeding of the <s>Saṅgha</s>, afterwards engages in disparagement — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 54

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.55:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur evaṃ vadet tathāhaṃ bhagavato dharma(ṃ) deśitam ājānāmi ye antarāyikā dharmās tāṃ pratiṣevato nālam antarāyāyeti sa bhikṣur bhikṣubhir evaṃ syād vacanīyo mā tvam āyuṣmann evaṃ vada tathāhaṃ bhagavato dharmaṃ deśitam ājānāmi ye antarāyikā dharmās tāṃ pratiṣevato nālam antarāyāyeti
mā bhagavantaṃ vivada mā bhagavantam abhyākhyāhi na sādhu bhagavato 'bhyākhyānaṃ bhavati na ca punar bhagavān evaṃ vaded anekaparyāyeṇa bhagavatā antarāyikā dharmāḥ samānā antarāyikā dharmā ity uktās tāṃś ca pratiṣevato 'lam antarāyāyeti niḥsṛja tvam āyuṣmann idam evaṃrūpaṃ pāpakaṃ dṛṣṭigatam
eva(ṃ) ce(t sa) bhikṣur bhikṣubhir ucyamānas tad vastu pratiniḥsṛjed ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ na cet pratiniḥsṛjed dvir api trir api samanuśāsitavyas tasya vastunaḥ pratiniḥsargāya (dv)ir api trir api samanuśiṣyamāṇas tad vastu pratiniḥsṛjed ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ no cet pratiniḥsṛjet pātayantikā 55
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.55:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should say thus: 'I understand the <s>Dharma</s> taught by the <s>Bhagavat</s> in such a way that the things declared as obstructive are not sufficient to cause obstruction for one who practices them' — that <s>bhikṣu</s> should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'Let the venerable one not say thus: "I understand the <s>Dharma</s> taught by the <s>Bhagavat</s> in such a way that the things declared as obstructive are not sufficient to cause obstruction for one who practices them."
Do not misrepresent the <s>Bhagavat</s>; do not slander the <s>Bhagavat</s>. It is not good to slander the <s>Bhagavat</s>. The <s>Bhagavat</s> would never say such a thing. In many ways the <s>Bhagavat</s> has declared obstructive things to be truly obstructive, and for one who practices them, they are sufficient to cause obstruction. Let the venerable one relinquish this evil wrong view.'
If that <s>bhikṣu</s>, when so addressed by the <s>bhikṣus</s>, relinquishes that matter — thus it is well. If he does not relinquish it, he must be admonished a second and a third time for the relinquishing of that matter. If, when being so admonished a second and a third time, he relinquishes that matter — thus it is well. If he does not relinquish it — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 55

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.56:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānaṃs tathāvādinaṃ pudgalam akṛtānudharmāṇam apratiniḥsṛṣṭena pāpakena dṛṣṭigatena saṃbhuṃjīta vā saṃvased vā tena vā sārdhaṃ sahāgāraśayyāṃ kalpayet pātayantikā (5)6
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.56:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> knowingly eats with, lodges with, or shares a sleeping place in the same room with a person who holds such views, who has not acted in conformity with the <s>Dharma</s>, and who has not relinquished his evil wrong view — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 56

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.57:
śramaṇoddeśaś ced evaṃ vadet tathāhaṃ bhagavato dharmaṃ deśitam ājānāmi yat kāmāṃ pratiṣevato nālam antarāyāyeti / sa śramaṇoddeśo bhikṣubhir evaṃ syād vacanīyo mā tvam āyuṣmaṃ śramaṇoddeśa evaṃ vada tathāhaṃ bhagavato dharmaṃ deśitam ājānāmi yat kāmāṃ pratiṣevato nālam antarāyāyeti
mā bhagavantaṃ vivada mā bhagavantam abhyākhyāhi na sādhu bhagavato 'bhyākhyānaṃ bhavati na ca punar bhagavān evaṃ vaded anekaparyāyeṇa bhagavatā antarāyikāḥ kāmāḥ samānā antarāyikā ity uktās tāṃś ca pratiṣevato 'lam antarāyāyeti niḥsṛja tvaṃ śramaṇoddeśa idam evaṃrūpaṃ pāpakaṃ dṛṣṭigatam
evaṃ cet sa śramaṇoddeśo bhikṣubhir ucyamānas tat pāpakaṃ dṛṣṭigataṃ pratiniḥsṛjed ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ no cet pratiniḥsṛje(d) dvir api trir api samanuśāsitavyas tasya vastunaḥ pratiniḥsargāya sa yāva(d) dvir api trir api samanuśiṣyamāṇa(ḥ) sacet pratiniḥsṛjed ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ no cet pratiniḥsṛjet sa śramaṇod(d)eśo bhikṣubhir evaṃ syād vacanīyaḥ
adyāgreṇa te śramaṇoddeśa na sa bhagavāṃ śāstā vyapadeṣṭavyo nāpy anye bhikṣavaḥ samanubandhitavyā yām apy anye śramaṇodd(eś)ā labhante bhikṣubhiḥ sārdhaṃ dvirātraṃ sahāgāraśayyāṃ sāpi te adyāgreṇa nāsti cara pareṇa mohapuruṣa naśya tvaṃ na tvayeha vastavyam iti /
yaḥ punar bhikṣur jānaṃs tathānāśitaṃ śramaṇoddeśam upasthāpayed vā upalāḍayed vā tena vā sārdhaṃ sahāgāraśayyāṃ kalpayet pātayantikā 57
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.57:
If a novice (<s>śramaṇoddeśa</s>) should say thus: 'I understand the <s>Dharma</s> taught by the <s>Bhagavat</s> in such a way that sensual pleasures, for one who practices them, are not sufficient to cause obstruction' — that novice should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'Let the venerable novice not say thus: "I understand the <s>Dharma</s> taught by the <s>Bhagavat</s> in such a way that sensual pleasures, for one who practices them, are not sufficient to cause obstruction."
Do not misrepresent the <s>Bhagavat</s>; do not slander the <s>Bhagavat</s>. It is not good to slander the <s>Bhagavat</s>. The <s>Bhagavat</s> would never say such a thing. In many ways the <s>Bhagavat</s> has declared sensual pleasures to be truly obstructive, and for one who practices them, they are sufficient to cause obstruction. Let the novice relinquish this evil wrong view.'
If that novice, when so addressed by the <s>bhikṣus</s>, relinquishes that evil wrong view — thus it is well. If he does not relinquish it, he must be admonished a second and a third time for the relinquishing of that matter. If, when being so admonished a second and a third time, he relinquishes it — thus it is well. If he does not relinquish it, that novice should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus:
'From this day forward, novice, you may not designate the <s>Bhagavat</s> as your teacher, nor may you associate with other <s>bhikṣus</s>. Even the privilege that other novices have of sharing a sleeping place in the same room with <s>bhikṣus</s> for two nights — that too is henceforth denied to you. Go elsewhere, deluded one! Begone! You may not remain here.'
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> knowingly supports, encourages, or shares a sleeping place in the same room with a novice who has been thus expelled — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 57

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.58:
yaḥ punar bhikṣu ratnaṃ vā ratnasaṃmataṃ vā svahastam udgṛhṇīyād udgrāhayed vā anyatrādhyārāmagatād vā adhyāvāsagatād vā pātayantikā adhyārāmagataṃ adhyāvāsagataṃ ratnaṃ vā ratnasaṃmataṃ vā evaṃcittenodgṛhītavyam udgrāhayitavyaṃ vā yasya bhaviṣyati sa enaṃ hariṣyati iyaṃ tatra sāmīciḥ 58
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.58:
If a <s>bhikṣu</s> picks up or causes to be picked up a jewel or something considered a jewel with his own hand, except [when it is found] within a monastery or within a dwelling — <s>pātayantikā</s>. A jewel or something considered a jewel [found] within a monastery or within a dwelling should be picked up or caused to be picked up with this thought: 'Whoever it belongs to will take it away.' This is the proper course of action herein. 58

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.59:
navacīvarapratilābhād bhikṣuṇā trayāṇāṃ durvarṇīkaraṇānām anyatamānyatamam ādātavyaṃ navasya durvarṇīkaraṇāya nīlaṃ vā kardamo vā kāḍiśāmo vā anādāya ced bhikṣus trayāṇāṃ durvarṇīkaraṇānām anyatamānyatamaṃ durvarṇīkaraṇaṃ navaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuṃjīta pātayantikā 59
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Pāt</s>.59:
Upon obtaining a new robe, a <s>bhikṣu</s> must apply one of the three means of disfigurement for the disfigurement of the new [robe]: either dark blue (<s>nīla</s>), mud (<s>kardama</s>), or black-brown (<s>kāḍiśāma</s>). If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, without having applied one of the three means of disfigurement, wears a new robe — <s>pātayantikā</s>. 59

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.60:
ardhamāsikaṃ snātram anyatra samayāt tadatikrāmataḥ pātayantikā tatrāyaṃ samayaḥ sārdho māsaḥ śeṣo grīṣmasya pūrvo māso varṣāṇām etau sārdhau dvau māsau paridāghasamayaḥ avaśiṣṭaṃ glānasamayaḥ karmasamayo vātasamayo vṛṣṭisamayo 'dhvānamārgasamayo 'yaṃ tatra samayaḥ 60 //
children.translated_text: Bathing is [permitted] once every half-month, except at the proper time — one who exceeds this: <s>Pātayantikā</s>. The proper time here is: one and a half months — the remainder of summer and the first month of the rains; these one and a half or two months are the hot season. The remaining [proper times] are: the time of illness, the time of work, the time of wind, the time of rain, and the time of traveling on a road. This is the proper time. 60.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.61:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ saṃcintya tīryagyonigataṃ prāṇinaṃ jīvitād vyaparopayet pātayantikā 61
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> intentionally deprives an animal of life — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 61.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.62:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣoḥ saṃcintya kaukṛtyam upasaṃhared viheṭhanāprekṣī kaccid asya bhikṣor muhūrtam api tāvad aphāṣaṃ bhaved idam eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā nānyathā pātayantikā (6)2
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> intentionally causes remorse in a <s>bhikṣu</s>, looking to cause distress, [thinking]: 'Perhaps that <s>bhikṣu</s> will be discomforted even for a moment' — doing so for this reason and no other — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 62.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.63:
aṅgulipratodanāt pātayantikā (6)3
children.translated_text: For tickling with the finger — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 63.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.64:
udakaharṣaṇāt pātayantikā (6)4
children.translated_text: For playing in water — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 64.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.65:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur mātṛgrāmeṇa sārdhaṃ sahāgāraśayyāṃ kalpayet pātayantikā (6)5
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should share a sleeping place in the same room with a woman — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 65.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.66:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣuṃ bhīṣayed bhīṣāpayed vā antato hāsyaprekṣyam api pātayantikā (6)6
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should frighten or cause to frighten a <s>bhikṣu</s>, even as a joke — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 66.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.67:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣoḥ pātraṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā kuñcikaṃ vā upānahaṃ vā sūcīgharakaṃ vā anyatamānyatamaṃ vā śrāmaṇakaṃ pariṣkāram upanidadhyād upanidhāpayed vā antato hāsyaprekṣyam api pātayantikā 67
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should hide a <s>bhikṣu</s>'s bowl, robe, key, sandals, needle-case, or any other requisite of a renunciant, or have it hidden, even as a joke — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 67.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.68:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣoḥ pātraṃ vā cīvaram vā dat(t)vā tataḥ paścād apratyuddhārya paribhuṃjīta pātayantikā 68
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having given a bowl or robe to a <s>bhikṣu</s>, should afterward use it without taking it back — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 68.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.69:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣum amūlakena saṃghāvaśeṣeṇa dharmeṇānudhvaṃsayet pātayantikā 69
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should accuse a <s>bhikṣu</s> of a <s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> offense without basis — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 69.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.70:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur mātṛgrāmeṇa sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya samānamārgaṃ pratipadyeta antato grāmāntaram api pātayantikā 70 //
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having arranged with a woman, should travel the same road, even as far as between one village and another — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 70.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.71:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ steyasārthena sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya samānamārgaṃ pratipadyeta antato grāmāntaram api pātayantikā 71
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having arranged with a band of thieves, should travel the same road, even as far as between one village and another — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 71.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.72:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur ūnaviṃśativarṣaṃ pudgalaṃ bhikṣubhāvenopasaṃpādayet pātayantikā sa ca pudgalo 'nupasaṃpannas te ca bhikṣavo garhyā iyaṃ tatra sāmīciḥ 72
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should give full ordination (<s>upasaṃpadā</s>) as a <s>bhikṣu</s> to a person under twenty years of age — <s>Pātayantikā</s>. That person is not ordained, and those <s>bhikṣus</s> are blameworthy. This is the proper procedure in this matter. 72.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.73:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ pṛthivīṃ khanyāt khānayed vā pātayantikā (7)3
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should dig the earth or have it dug — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 73.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.74:
caturmāsikā bhikṣuṇā pravāraṇā sādhayitavyā anyatra nityapravāraṇāyā anyatra punaḥpunaḥpravāraṇāyā anyatra pratyekapravāraṇāyā tata uttaraṃ sādhayet pātayantikā 74
children.translated_text: An invitation (<s>pravāraṇā</s>) is to be accepted by a <s>bhikṣu</s> once every four months, except for a standing invitation, except for a repeated invitation, except for a separate invitation. Should he accept beyond that — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 74.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.75:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣubhir ucyamāna iha te śikṣāyāṃ śikṣitavyam ity evaṃ vaden nāhaṃ yuṣmākaṃ bālānāṃ mūḍhānāṃ duṣprajñānāṃ vacanenātra śikṣāyāṃ śikṣiṣyāmi anyān ahaṃ bhikṣūṃ prakṣyāmi sūtradharān vinayadharān mātṛkādharān iti pātayantikā / ājñātukāmena bhikṣuṇā tatra śikṣāyāṃ śikṣitavyaṃ bhikṣavaś ca praṣṭavyāḥ sūtradharā vinayadharā mātṛkādharāḥ / iyaṃ tatra sāmīciḥ 75
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, when admonished by <s>bhikṣus</s> saying 'You should train here in this training,' should say: 'I will not train in this training on the word of you foolish, deluded, unwise ones; I shall ask other <s>bhikṣus</s> who are experts in the <s>sūtras</s>, experts in the <s>Vinaya</s>, and experts in the <s>Mātṛkā</s>' — <s>Pātayantikā</s>. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who wishes to know should train in that training and should ask <s>bhikṣus</s> who are experts in the <s>sūtras</s>, experts in the <s>Vinaya</s>, and experts in the <s>Mātṛkā</s>. This is the proper procedure in this matter. 75.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.76:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur bhikṣūṇāṃ kalahajātānāṃ bhaṇḍanajātānāṃ vigṛhītānāṃ vivādam āpannānāṃ tūṣṇīm upaśrutikas tiṣṭhed yad ete bhikṣavo vakṣyanti tad ahaṃ śrutvā tathānuvyāhariṣyāmīti pā(tayantikā) (7)6
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, when <s>bhikṣus</s> have fallen into a quarrel, dispute, argument, or conflict, should stand silently eavesdropping, [thinking]: 'Whatever these <s>bhikṣus</s> will say, I, having heard it, will repeat accordingly' — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 76.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.77:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ saṃghasy(a) n(i)ścitāyāṃ kathāyāṃ vartamānāyāṃ tūṣṇīm utthāya prakramet saṃtaṃ bhikṣum anava(lokya pātaya)ntikā (77)
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, while the <s>Saṃgha</s> is engaged in a matter that has been decided, should rise silently and leave without informing a <s>bhikṣu</s> present — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 77.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.78:
anādareyakāt pātayantikā (7)8
children.translated_text: For showing disrespect — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 78.

children.text: PrMoSū_Pāt.79:
surāmaireyamadyapānāt pātayantikā 79
children.translated_text: For drinking liquor, fermented drink, or intoxicants — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 79.

children.text: PrMoSū_Pāt.80:
children.translated_text: [Rule 80:]

children.text: yaḥ punar bhikṣur akāle grāmaṃ praviśet santaṃ bhikṣum anavalokyānyatra tathārūpapratyayāt pātayantikā 80 //
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should enter a village at an improper time without informing a <s>bhikṣu</s> present, except for a suitable reason — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 80.
[Rule 79:]

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.81:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sabhaktaṃ(?) kuleṣūpanimantritaḥ pūrvabhaktaṃ paścādbhaktaṃ kuleṣu cāritram āpadyeta pā(tayantikā) 81
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having been invited [to eat] at a household with food [already prepared], should before or after the meal visit other households — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 81.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.82:
yaḥ punar bhikṣu rājñaḥ kṣatriyasya mūrdhābhiṣiktasya ani(ṣk)rānte rājñ(i) anirgṛhīteṣu ratneṣu indrakīlaṃ vā indrakīlabhūmiṃ vā samatikramed anyatra tathārūpapratyayāt pātayantikā (8)2
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should cross the threshold or the threshold-ground of an anointed <s>Kṣatriya</s> king before the king has departed and before the royal treasures have been put away, except for a suitable reason — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 82.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.83:
yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ prātimokṣasūtroddiśyamāne evaṃ vaded idānīm ahaṃ jānāmi yad aya(ṃ) dharmaḥ sūtragataḥ sūtraparyāpanna iti taṃ ca bhikṣavo jānīyuḥ saṃniṣaṇṇapūrvo 'yam āyuṣmāṃ dvis triḥ prātimokṣasūtroddeśe kaḥ punar vādo bhūya iti tasya punar bhikṣor nāsty ajñānān mokṣo
yāṃ cāpattim āpannaḥ syāt tāṃ yathādharmaṃ kārayitavya uttarañ ca saṃvejayitavyas tasya te āyuṣmann alābho na lābhaḥ durlabdho na sulabdhaḥ yo hi nāma tvam anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddiśyamāne na satkṛtyārthīkṛtvā na gurukṛtvā na manasīkṛtvā naikāgracitto nāvahitaśrotro na sarvacetasā samanvāhṛtya śṛṇoṣi iyaṃ tasya saṃvejanāt pātayantikā (8)3
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, while the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> is being recited, should say: 'Now I know that this <s>dharma</s> [rule] is included in the <s>sūtra</s> and is part of the <s>sūtra</s>' — and if the <s>bhikṣus</s> should know: 'This venerable one has sat through the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> recitation two or three times before, not to mention more' — then there is no excuse of ignorance for that <s>bhikṣu</s>. Whatever offense he has committed, he should be dealt with for it according to the rule. And in addition he should be reproached for it: 'It is not good for you, venerable one; it is not fitting for you that while the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> is being recited you cannot properly attend to it.' <s>Pātayantikā</s> 83.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.84:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur asthimayaṃ dantamayaṃ viṣāṇamayaṃ vā sūcīgharakaṃ kārayet pātaya(n)tikā (8)4
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should have a needle-case made of bone, ivory, or horn — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 84.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.85:
pīṭhaṃ vā bhikṣuṇā mañcaṃ vā kārayatā sugatāṣṭāṅgulipramāṇāḥ pādāḥ kārayitavyā anyatrāraṇyās tata uttaraṃ kārayet p(ātayantikā 8)5
children.translated_text: When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a bed or chair made, the legs should be made to the <s>Sugata</s>'s eight-finger measure, not counting the frame above. Should he have them made beyond that — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 85.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.86:
yaḥ punar bhikṣus tūlasaṃstṛtāṃ śayyām avanahed avanāhayed vā pātayantikā (8)6
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should stuff a bedding with cotton or have it stuffed — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 86.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.87:
varṣāśāṭīcīvaraṃ bhikṣuṇā kārayatā prāmāṇikaṃ kārayitavyaṃ tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ dīrghataḥ ṣaḍ vitastayaḥ sugatavitastyā tīryak sārdhe dve tata uttaraṃ kārayet pātayantikā (8)7
children.translated_text: When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a rain-cloak robe made, it should be made to the proper measure. The measure here is: six spans in length by the <s>Sugata</s>'s span, two and a half in breadth. Should he have it made beyond that — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 87.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.88:
kaṇḍupraticchādanaṃ bhikṣuṇā kārayatā prāmāṇikaṃ kārayitavyaṃ tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ dīrghataś catasro vitastayaḥ sugatavitastyā tīryag dve tata uttaraṃ kārayet pātayantikā (8)8
children.translated_text: When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having an itch-covering cloth made, it should be made to the proper measure. The measure here is: four spans in length by the <s>Sugata</s>'s span, two in breadth. Should he have it made beyond that — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 88.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pāt.89:
niṣīdanaṃ bhikṣuṇā kārayatā prāmāṇikaṃ kārayitavyaṃ tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ dīrghato vitastī dve sugatavitastyā tīryak sārdhavitastir daśānāṃ ca vitastis tata uttaraṃ kārayet pātayantikā 89
children.translated_text: When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a sitting-cloth (<s>niṣīdana</s>) made, it should be made to the proper measure. The measure here is: two spans in length by the <s>Sugata</s>'s span, one and a half in breadth, with a border of a tenth of a span. Should he have it made beyond that — <s>Pātayantikā</s> 89.

children.text: PrMoSū_Pāt.90:

yaḥ punar bhikṣuḥ sugatacīvarapramāṇena cīvaraṃ kārayed uttaraṃ vā sugatacīvarāt pātayantikā / tatredaṃ sugatacīvarapramāṇaṃ dīrghato nava vitastayaḥ sugatavitastyā tīryak ṣaḍ idaṃ tatra sugatacīvarapramāṇaṃ 90 //
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should have a robe made to the <s>Sugata</s>'s robe measure or exceeding the <s>Sugata</s>'s robe [measure] — <s>Pātayantikā</s>. The <s>Sugata</s>'s robe measure here is: nine spans in length by the <s>Sugata</s>'s span, six in breadth. This is the <s>Sugata</s>'s robe measure. 90.
[Rule 90:]

children.text: uddiṣṭā mayāyuṣmanto navati pātayantikā dharmās tatrāham āyuṣmataḥ pṛcchāmi kaccit sthātra pariśuddhā dvir api trir api pṛcchāmi kaccit sthātra par(i)ś(uddhā pariśu)ddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi //
children.translated_text: Venerable ones, the ninety <s>Pātayantikā</s> offenses have been recited by me. I ask the venerable ones: are you pure in this matter? A second and third time I ask: are you pure in this matter? The venerable ones are pure in this matter, since they remain silent. Thus I understand it.

children.text: VI. pratideśanīyā dharmāḥ
children.translated_text: VI. <s>Pratideśanīya</s> (Offenses Requiring Confession) Offenses

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pratid.0:
ime punar āyuṣmantaś catvāraḥ pratideśanīyā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam āgacchanti //
children.translated_text: Venerable ones, these four <s>Pratideśanīya</s> (confession) offenses come up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> every half-month.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pratid.1:
yaḥ punar bhikṣur aglāno 'ntargṛhaṃ piṇḍāya carantyā ajñātyā bhikṣuṇyāḥ santikāt svahastaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt tena bhikṣuṇā bhikṣ(ū)ṇām antike pratideśayitavyaṃ garhaṇīyam āyuṣmantaḥ sthānam āpanno 'smi asāṃpreyaṃ pratideśanīyaṃ taṃ dharmaṃ pratideśayāmi ayaṃ dharmaḥ pratideśanīyaḥ 1
children.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, being not ill, should accept with his own hand hard or soft food from an unrelated <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is going about for alms within houses, that <s>bhikṣu</s> should confess before the <s>bhikṣus</s>: 'Venerable ones, I have committed a blameworthy act, an unseemly <s>Pratideśanīya</s> offense. I confess that offense.' This is the first <s>Pratideśanīya</s> offense.

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pratid.2:
bhikṣavaḥ punaḥ saṃbahulāḥ kuleṣūpanimantritā bhuṃjīraṃs tatra ced bhikṣuṇī vyapadiśamānā sthitā syād ihaudanaṃ dehi iha sūpaṃ dehi iha bhūyo dehīti sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣubhir evaṃ syād vacanīyā āgamaya tāva(t) tvaṃ (bh)aginī yāvad ime bhikṣavo bhuṃjantām ity ekabhikṣor api ce(n) na pratibhāyāt tāṃ bhikṣuṇī(m) evaṃ vaktum āgamaya tāva(t) tvaṃ (bha)ginī yā(vad i)me bhikṣ(avo bhuṃjantām iti) sarvais tair bhikṣ(u)bhir bhik(ṣū)ṇām antike pratideśayitavyaṃ garh(a)ṇ(īyam) āyuṣmantaḥ sthānam āpannā(ḥ) sma asāṃpreyaṃ pratideśanīyaṃ taṃ dharmaṃ pratide(śa)y(āma aya)ṃ dharma(ḥ) prati(d)eśanīyaḥ 2
children.translated_text: <s>Pratideśanīya</s> 2: If several <s>bhikṣus</s> who have been invited [to eat] at households should be eating, and a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should stand there directing [the distribution], [saying]: 'Give rice here, give soup here, give more here' — that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus:

children.text:
PrMoSū_Pratid.3:
yāni punas tāni saṃghasya śaikṣasaṃmatāni kulāni bhavanti śaikṣasaṃvṛtisaṃmatāni yaḥ punar bhikṣus tathārūpebhyaḥ kulebhyaḥ (śai)kṣasaṃ(vṛti)s(aṃma)tebhyaḥ pūrvam animantritaḥ samānaḥ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt tena bhikṣuṇā bhikṣūṇām antike pratideśayitavyaṃ garhaṇīyam āyuṣmantaḥ sthānam āpanno 'smi asāṃpreyaṃ pratideśanīyaṃ taṃ dharmaṃ pratideśayāmi ayaṃ dharmaḥ pratideśanīyaḥ 3
children.translated_text: <s>Pratideśanīya</s> 3: There are certain families which are designated by the <s>Saṃgha</s> as 'under training' (<s>śaikṣa-saṃvṛti-saṃmata</s>). If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, without having been previously invited, should [accept food] from such families designated as under training —

children.text: PrMoSū_Pratid.4:

yāni punas tāni saṃghasyāraṇyakāni śayyāsanāni bhavanti sāśaṃkasaṃmatāni sabhayasaṃmatāni sapratibhayabhairavasaṃmatāni / yaḥ punar bhikṣus tathārūpeṣu saṃghasyāraṇyakeṣu śayyāsaneṣu pūrvapratisaṃvedakaḥ asaṃmataḥ saṃghena bahir ārāmasya svahastaṃ khādanīyabhojanīyaṃ apratigṛhya antar ārāme pratigṛhṇīyāt tena bhikṣuṇā bhikṣ(ū)ṇām antike pratideśayitavyaṃ garhaṇīyam āyuṣmantaḥ sthānam āpanno 'smi asāṃpreyaṃ pratideśanīyaṃ ta(ṃ) dharmaṃ pratideśayāmi ayam api dharmaḥ pratideśanīyaḥ 4 //
children.translated_text: There are certain wilderness dwellings of the <s>Saṃgha</s> which are designated as dangerous, fearful, and terrifying. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, without prior arrangement, in such wilderness dwellings of the <s>Saṃgha</s>
<s>Pratideśanīya</s> 4:

children.text: uddiṣṭā mayāyuṣmantaś catvāraḥ pratideśanīyā dharmās tatrāham āyuṣmataḥ pṛcchāmi kaccid sthātra pariśuddhā dvir api t(ri)r api pṛcchāmi kaccit sthātra pariśuddhā(ḥ) pariśuddhā (a)trāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi //
children.translated_text: Venerable Ones, four <s>Pratideśanīya</s> rules have been recited by me. Here I ask the Venerable Ones: are you pure in this? A second time I ask: are you pure in this? A third time I ask: are you pure in this? The Venerable Ones are pure in this, since they are silent.

children.text: VII. śaikṣā dharmāḥ
children.translated_text: VII. The Training Rules (<s>Śaikṣa Dharmāḥ</s>)

children.text: ime punar āyuṣmantaḥ saṃbahulāḥ śaikṣā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam āgacchanti //
children.translated_text: These, Venerable Ones, are the numerous training rules (<s>śaikṣa dharmāḥ</s>) that come up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> every half-month.

children.text: A
children.translated_text: A

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.1:
nātyutkṛṣṭaṃ cīvaraṃ nivāsayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 1
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> A.1: 'We shall not wear the robe too high' — this is a training rule to be observed. 1

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.2:
nātyavakṛṣṭaṃ cīvaraṃ nivāsayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 2
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> A.2: 'We shall not wear the robe too low' — this is a training rule to be observed. 2

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.3:
na vikīrṇaṃ cīvaraṃ nivāsayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 3
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> A.3: 'We shall not wear the robe loosely spread out' — this is a training rule to be observed. 3

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.4:
na vāsijhaḍakaṃ cīvaraṃ nivāsayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 4

children.text:

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.6:
na hastiśuṇḍaṃ cīvaraṃ nivāsayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 6
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> A.6: 'We shall not wear the robe [draped] like an elephant's trunk' — this is a training rule to be observed. 6

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.7:
na kunmāṃsapiṇḍaṃ cīvaraṃ nivāsayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 7
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> A.7: 'We shall not wear the robe [gathered] like a lump of tortoise-meat' — this is a training rule to be observed. 7

children.text:

na kalāpakaṃ cīvaraṃ nivāsayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 8

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.9:

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> A.9: 'We shall not wear the robe [folded] like a drum' — this is a training rule to be observed. 9

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.10:
na milimaṃ cīvaraṃ nivasayiṣyāma iti śi(kṣā karaṇīyā) 10

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.11:
na cūrṇasūtraṃ cī(varaṃ nivāsayiṣyāma iti śikṣā kara)ṇīyā 11
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> A.11: 'We shall not wear the robe [arranged] like a twisted thread' — this is a training rule to be observed. 11

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.12:
parimaṇḍalaṃ cīvaraṃ nivāsay(i)ṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 12
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> A.12: 'We shall wear the robe evenly all around' — this is a training rule to be observed. 12

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.13:
nātyutkṛṣṭaṃ cīvaraṃ prāvariṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 13
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> A.13: 'We shall not wear the upper robe too high' — this is a training rule to be observed. 13

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.14:
nātyavakṛṣṭaṃ cīvaraṃ (prā)variṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 14

children.text:

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.A.16:
parimaṇḍalaṃ cīvaraṃ prāvariṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīy(ā) 16 //
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> A.16: 'We shall wear the upper robe evenly all around' — this is a training rule to be observed. 16

children.translated_text: B

susaṃvṛtā antargṛhaṃ pravekṣyām(a iti śikṣā) karaṇīy(ā) 1

children.text:

children.text:

children.text:

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.7: 'We shall enter a house with little noise' — this is a training rule to be observed. 7

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.8:
alpaśabdā (a)ntarg(ṛ)he niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīy(ā) 8

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.10:
noccagghikay(ā a)ntargṛhe niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīy(ā) 10
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.10: 'We shall not sit in a house with loud laughter' — this is a training rule to be observed. 10

children.text:

notkuṭukā (a)ntargṛhaṃ pravekṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 11

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.15:

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.17: 'We shall not enter a house with hands on hips' — this is a training rule to be observed. 17

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.19: 'We shall not enter a house with a jaunty gait' — this is a training rule to be observed. 19

PrMoSū_Śai.B.20:

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.20: 'We shall not sit in a house with a jaunty manner' — this is a training rule to be observed. 20

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.21:
nātyastikākṛtā (a)ntargṛhaṃ pravekṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 21
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.21: 'We shall not enter a house stretching out [the limbs]' — this is a training rule to be observed. 21

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.22:

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.22: 'We shall not sit in a house stretching out [the limbs]' — this is a training rule to be observed. 22

na vinyastikākṛtā antargṛhaṃ pravekṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 23
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.23: 'We shall not enter a house with hands dangling' — this is a training rule to be observed. 23

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.24:
na vinyastikākṛtā antargṛhe niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 24
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.24: 'We shall not sit in a house with hands dangling' — this is a training rule to be observed. 24

PrMoSū_Śai.B.25:
na vikṣiptikākṛtā antargṛhaṃ pravekṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 25
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.25: 'We shall not enter a house with arms swinging' — this is a training rule to be observed. 25

PrMoSū_Śai.B.26:
na vikṣiptikākṛtā antargṛhe niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 26
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.26: 'We shall not sit in a house with arms swinging' — this is a training rule to be observed. 26

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.27: 'We shall not enter a house sitting cross-legged' — this is a training rule to be observed. 27

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.28: 'We shall not sit in a house sitting cross-legged' — this is a training rule to be observed. 28

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.30: 'We shall not sit in a house swinging the arms' — this is a training rule to be observed. 30

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.31: 'We shall not enter a house swaying the shoulders' — this is a training rule to be observed. 31

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.32:
na cāṃsapracālakā antargṛhe niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 3(2)
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.32: 'We shall not sit in a house swaying the shoulders' — this is a training rule to be observed. 32

children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.33: 'We shall not enter a house shaking the head' — this is a training rule to be observed. 33

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.34:
na śīrṣapracālakā antargṛhe niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (34)
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.34: 'We shall not sit in a house shaking the head' — this is a training rule to be observed. 34

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.35:
na kāyapracālakā antargṛhaṃ pravekṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (35)
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.35: 'We shall not enter a house swaying the body' — this is a training rule to be observed. 35

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.36:
na kāyapracālakā antargṛhe niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 36
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.36: 'We shall not sit in a house swaying the body' — this is a training rule to be observed. 36

PrMoSū_Śai.B.37:
na hastasaṃlagnikayāntargṛhaṃ pravekṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (37)
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.37: 'We shall not enter a house with hands clasped [with another]' — this is a training rule to be observed. 37

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.38:
na hastasaṃlagnikayāntargṛhe niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 38
children.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣa</s> B.38: 'We shall not sit in a house with hands clasped [with another]' — this is a training rule to be observed. 38

children.text:

children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.B.39:
We shall not enter a house with arms akimbo — this is the training to be observed. (39)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.40:
na viḍaṅgikayāntargṛhe niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (40)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.B.40:
We shall not sit in a house with arms akimbo — this is the training to be observed. (40)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.41:
na pāde pādam ādhāyāntargṛhe niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 41
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.B.41:
We shall not sit in a house with one foot placed upon the other — this is the training to be observed. (41)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.42:
na sakthni sakthy āropyāntargṛhe niṣatsyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 42
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.B.42:
We shall not sit in a house with one thigh placed upon the other — this is the training to be observed. (42)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.B.43:
na pāṇau hanum upādāyāntargṛhe niṣatsyāmo gṛhiṇo hāsyaprekṣiṇa iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 43 //
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.B.43:
We shall not sit in a house with chin resting on the hand, [as it makes] householders look on with mockery — this is the training to be observed. (43)

children.text: C
children.translated_text: C

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.1:
satkṛtyaudanaṃ pratigṛhīṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 1
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.1:
We shall receive rice with respect — this is the training to be observed. (1)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.2:
satkṛtya sūpaṃ pratigṛhīṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 2
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.2:
We shall receive curry with respect — this is the training to be observed. (2)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.3:
na stūpākāraṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 3
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.3:
We shall not eat alms-food heaped up in the shape of a <s>stūpa</s> — this is the training to be observed. (3)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.4:
samatittik(aṃ pi)ṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma it(i śikṣā kara)ṇīy(ā) 4
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.4:
We shall eat alms-food level with the rim [of the bowl] — this is the training to be observed. (4)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.5:
samasūpikaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīy(ā) 5
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.5:
We shall eat alms-food with curry proportionate [to the rice] — this is the training to be observed. (5)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.6:
na stūpyavaguṇṭhīkṛtaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 6
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.6:
We shall not eat alms-food covered over in the shape of a <s>stūpa</s> [hiding curry under rice to get more] — this is the training to be observed. (6)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.7:
na vyutkaṇṭhaśaḥ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 7
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.7:
We shall not eat alms-food craning the neck forward — this is the training to be observed. (7)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.8:
nātimahāntam ālopaṃ kariṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 8
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.8:
We shall not make excessively large mouthfuls — this is the training to be observed. (8)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.9:
parimaṇḍalam ālopaṃ kariṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 9
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.9:
We shall make well-rounded mouthfuls — this is the training to be observed. (9)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.10:
nānāgate ālope mukhadvāraṃ vivariṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 10
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.10:
We shall not open the mouth before the morsel has arrived — this is the training to be observed. (10)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.11:
na sālopena mukhadvāreṇa vyāhariṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 11
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.11:
We shall not speak with a morsel in the mouth — this is the training to be observed. (11)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.12:
na kabaḍacchedakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 12
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.12:
We shall not eat alms-food by biting off pieces [from a lump] — this is the training to be observed. (12)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.13:
na śuśukkārakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 13
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.13:
We shall not eat alms-food making a slurping sound — this is the training to be observed. (13)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.14:
na cucukkārakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (1)4
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.14:
We shall not eat alms-food making a sucking sound — this is the training to be observed. (14)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.15:
na phuphukkārakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śi(kṣā) karaṇī y(ā) 15
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.15:
We shall not eat alms-food making a blowing or puffing sound — this is the training to be observed. (15)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.16:
na gṛṣmahārakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (16)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.16:
We shall not eat alms-food scraping [the bowl] — this is the training to be observed. (16)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.17:
nojjighranta(ḥ) piṇḍapātaṃ pari(bhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 17)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.17:
We shall not eat alms-food while sniffing [it] — this is the training to be observed. (17)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.18:
na jihvāniścārakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (1)8
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.18:
We shall not eat alms-food sticking out the tongue — this is the training to be observed. (18)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.19:
na hastāvalehakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (19)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.19:
We shall not eat alms-food licking the hands — this is the training to be observed. (19)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.20:
na pātrāvalehakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 20
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.20:
We shall not eat alms-food licking the bowl — this is the training to be observed. (20)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.21:
na hastāvadhūnakaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 21
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.21:
We shall not eat alms-food shaking the hands [to remove food scraps] — this is the training to be observed. (21)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.22:
na śistavikiraṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 22
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.22:
We shall not eat alms-food scattering leftovers — this is the training to be observed. (22)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.23:
na sāmiṣeṇa pāṇinā pānīyasthālakaṃ pratigṛhīṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 23
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.23:
We shall not accept a drinking-water vessel with a hand smeared with food — this is the training to be observed. (23)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.24:
nātmārtham aglānā odanaṃ vā sūpaṃ vā vijñāpayiṣyāma i(ti śikṣā karaṇīyā) 24
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.24:
We shall not, while not ill, request rice or curry for our own sake — this is the training to be observed. (24)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.25:
naudanena sūpaṃ praticchādayiṣyāmo bhūyaskāmatām upādāya iti śikṣā karaṇī(yā) 25
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.25:
We shall not cover the curry with rice out of desire to get more — this is the training to be observed. (25)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.26:
nāvadhyānaprekṣiṇa anantarikasya pātraṃ vyavalokayiṣyāma (i)ti (śikṣā karaṇ)īyā 26
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.26:
We shall not look with critical intent into the bowl of a neighbor — this is the training to be observed. (26)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.27:
pātrasaṃjñinaḥ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇī(yā 27)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.27:
We shall eat alms-food with attention on the bowl — this is the training to be observed. (27)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.28:
sāvadānaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhokṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 28
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.28:
We shall eat alms-food with mindfulness — this is the training to be observed. (28)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.C.29:
na sāmiṣaṃ pātrodakam antargṛhe chorayiṣyāmo gṛhiṇam anavalokyeti śikṣā karaṇīyā (29) //
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.C.29:
We shall not throw out bowl-rinsing water containing food scraps in a house without looking at the householder — this is the training to be observed. (29)
