children.translated_text: D

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.1:
na yānādhirūḍhasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 1
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.1:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and is mounted on a vehicle — this is the training to be observed. (1)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.2:
na purato gacchataḥ pṛṣṭhato 'nugacchanta aglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīy(ā) 2
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.2:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill, walking ahead while we follow behind — this is the training to be observed. (2)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.3:
na mārgaṃ gacchato hy amārg(aṃ ga)cchanta aglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 3
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.3:
We shall not, while going off the path, teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill going on the path — this is the training to be observed. (3)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.4:
na sthitā niṣaṇṇasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā (kara)ṇīy(ā) 4
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.4:
We shall not, while standing, teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and is seated — this is the training to be observed. (4)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.5:
na nīcāsan(e) niṣaṇṇā uccāsane niṣaṇṇasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā ka(raṇīyā) 5
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.5:
We shall not, while seated on a low seat, teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and is seated on a high seat — this is the training to be observed. (5)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.6:
na ni(ṣa)ṇṇā nipannasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyā(ma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 6)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.6:
We shall not, while seated, teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and is lying down — this is the training to be observed. (6)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.7:
na veṣ(ṭ)itaśirasa aglānasya dharma(ṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 7)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.7:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and has a wrapped head — this is the training to be observed. (7)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.8:
nāvaguṇḍikākṛtasyāglānasy(a dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma) iti (śikṣā karaṇīyā) 8
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.8:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and has the face covered — this is the training to be observed. (8)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.9:
na kaṃbhākṛtasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 9
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.9:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and stands with arms akimbo — this is the training to be observed. (9)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.10:
notkṛṣṭikākṛtasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣa karaṇīyā 10
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.10:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and squats with knees drawn up — this is the training to be observed. (10)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.11:
nātyastikākṛtasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 11
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.11:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and sits reclining — this is the training to be observed. (11)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.12:
na vinyastikākṛtasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 12
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.12:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and sits in a lounging posture — this is the training to be observed. (12)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.13:
na vikṣiptikākṛtasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 13
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.13:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and sits with limbs sprawled — this is the training to be observed. (13)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.14:
na pallatthikākṛtasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (14)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.14:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and sits cross-legged [in a disrespectful manner] — this is the training to be observed. (14)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.15:
na sopānahakasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā 15
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.15:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and is wearing sandals — this is the training to be observed. (15)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.16:
na sapādukasyāglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (16)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.16:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and is wearing shoes — this is the training to be observed. (16)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.17:
na daṇḍapāṇer aglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti (śikṣā kara)ṇīyā (17)
PrMoSū_Śai.D.18:
na cchatrapāṇer aglānasya dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti śikṣā karaṇīyā (18)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.17:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and holds a staff in hand — this is the training to be observed. (17)
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.18:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> to one who is not ill and holds an umbrella in hand — this is the training to be observed. (18)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.19:
na śastrapāṇeḥ sarvathā dharmaṃ deśayiṣyāma iti ś(i)kṣā karaṇīy(ā) 19
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.19:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> in any case to one holding a weapon in hand — this is the training to be observed. (19)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.20:
na khaḍgapā(ṇeḥ sa)rvathā (dha)rmaṃ deśayiṣ(y)ā(ma iti śikṣ)ā karaṇīyā 20
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.20:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> in any case to one holding a sword in hand — this is the training to be observed. (20)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.21:
nāyudhapāṇeḥ sarvathā dharma(ṃ) deśayiṣyāma iti śik(ṣ)ā kar(aṇ)īy(ā 21)
PrMoSū_Śai.D.22:
n(a) harita uccāraprasrāvaṃ khe(ṭaṃ śiṅghā)ṇakaṃ kariṣyāma iti (śikṣā karaṇīyā 22)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.21:
We shall not teach the <s>Dharma</s> in any case to one holding arms — this is the training to be observed. (21)
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.22:
We shall not defecate, urinate, spit, or discharge nasal mucus on green vegetation — this is the training to be observed. (22)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.23:
na kalpika udake pāribhogīye uccāraprasrāvaṃ kheṭaṃ śiṅghāṇakaṃ kariṣyāma iti śikṣā kara(ṇīyā 23)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.23:
We shall not defecate, urinate, spit, or discharge nasal mucus into usable or drinkable water — this is the training to be observed. (23)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.24:
na sthi(t)ā aglān(ā) uc(c)āraprasrāvaṃ kariṣyāma iti (śikṣā karaṇīyā 24)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.24:
We shall not, while not ill, defecate or urinate while standing — this is the training to be observed. (24)

children.text:
PrMoSū_Śai.D.25:
na sādhikapauruṣaṃ vṛkṣam ārokṣyāmo 'nyatra praty(ayād it)i śikṣā karaṇīyā 25 / /
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_Śai</s>.D.25:
We shall not climb a tree taller than a man's height, except for a [proper] reason — this is the training to be observed. (25)

children.text: uddiṣṭā mayāyuṣmantaḥ saṃbahu(lāḥ śaikṣā) dharmās tatrāham āyuṣmataḥ pṛcchāmi ka(cc)i(t sth)ā(tra) pariśudd(ā dvir api) tr(i)r api pṛcchāmi kaccit sthātra pariśu(ddhāḥ) pariśu(ddhā atrāy)uṣm(anto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi //)
children.translated_text: Venerable ones, I have recited the numerous <s>śaikṣa</s> (training) rules. Herein I ask the venerable ones: Are you pure in this matter? A second time and a third time I ask: Are you pure in this matter? The venerable ones are pure in this matter, since they remain silent. Thus do I hold it.

children.text: VIII. adhikaraṇaśamathā dharmāḥ
children.translated_text: VIII. Rules for the Settlement of Disputes (<s>adhikaraṇaśamatha dharmāḥ</s>)

children.text: (ime punar āyuṣmantaḥ saptādhi)karaṇa(śa)mathā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam āgacchanti /
children.translated_text: Venerable ones, these seven rules for the settlement of disputes (<s>adhikaraṇaśamatha dharmāḥ</s>) come up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s> every half-month.

children.text:
PrMoSū_AŚ.1:
saṃm(u)kha(v)inayārhasya saṃmukhavinay(aṃ dāsyāmaḥ 1)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_AŚ</s>.1:
To one deserving face-to-face adjudication (<s>saṃmukhavinaya</s>), we shall give face-to-face adjudication. (1)

children.text:
PrMoSū_AŚ.2:
(smṛti)vinayā(r)hasya (s)mṛti(vinayaṃ dāsyāma)ḥ 2
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_AŚ</s>.2:
To one deserving adjudication by recollection (<s>smṛtivinaya</s>), we shall give adjudication by recollection. (2)

children.text:
PrMoSū_AŚ.3:
amūḍha(v)i(na)yā(rhas)ya amūḍhavinayaṃ dāsyāmaḥ 3
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_AŚ</s>.3:
To one deserving adjudication for [past] insanity (<s>amūḍhavinaya</s>), we shall give adjudication for [past] insanity. (3)

children.text:
PrMoSū_AŚ.4:
pratijñāvinayārhasya pratijñāṃ kāra(yi)ṣyāma(ḥ) 4
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_AŚ</s>.4:
To one deserving adjudication by confession (<s>pratijñāvinaya</s>), we shall have him make a confession. (4)

children.text:
PrMoSū_AŚ.5:
tatsvabhāvaiṣikārhasya tatsvabhā(vaiṣikāṃ) dāsyāmaḥ 5
PrMoSū_AŚ.6:
yadbhūyeṣikārhasya yadbhūyeṣikaṃ dāsyāmaḥ 6
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_AŚ</s>.5:
To one deserving the determination of the nature [of the offense] (<s>tatsvabhāvaiṣikā</s>), we shall give the determination of the nature. (5)
<s>PrMoSū_AŚ</s>.6:
To one deserving decision by majority (<s>yadbhūyeṣikā</s>), we shall give decision by majority. (6)

children.text:
PrMoSū_AŚ.7:
utpanno(tpannāny adhikaraṇāni) tṛṇaprastārakena vyupaśamayiṣyāmo dharmeṇa .i... 7 (//)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū_AŚ</s>.7:
We shall settle disputes as they arise by the procedure of 'spreading grass' (<s>tṛṇaprastāraka</s>), in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s>. (7)

children.text: ud(d)iṣṭā mayāyuṣmantaḥ saptādhikaraṇaśamathā dharmās t(atrāham āyu)ṣmata(ḥ pṛ)cchāmi kaccit sthātra pariśuddhā dvir api tri(r api) pṛcchāmi kaccit sthātra (pariśuddhāḥ pari)śuddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam evāhaṃ dhārayāmi //
children.translated_text: The seven <s>adhikaraṇaśamatha</s> (means of settling disputes) offenses have been recited by me, venerable ones. I ask the venerable ones: are you pure in this matter? A second and third time I ask: are you pure in this matter? The venerable ones are pure in this matter, since they remain silent. Thus I understand it.

children.text: (SCHLUSSTEIL)
children.translated_text: (CONCLUDING SECTION)

children.text: I (Prosa)
children.translated_text: I (Prose)

children.text: udd(i)ṣṭ(a)ṃ mayāyuṣmantaḥ prātimokṣasūtrasya / / nidānaṃ uddiṣṭāś catvāraḥ pārājikā dharmā uddiṣṭās trayodaśa saṃghāvaśeṣā dharmā uddiṣṭau dvāv aniyatau dharmau uddiṣṭās triṃśa(n n)iḥsargikāḥ pātayantikā dharmā uddiṣṭā navati pātayantikā dharmā uddiṣṭāś catvāraḥ prat(i)deśanīyā dha(r)m(ā) u(ddi)ṣṭ(āḥ) saṃbahulā(ḥ) śaikṣā dharmā uddiṣṭāḥ saptādhikaraṇaśamathā dharmāḥ /
children.translated_text: The <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> has been recited by me, venerable ones. The introduction (<s>nidāna</s>) has been recited; the four <s>Pārājika</s> (defeat) offenses have been recited; the thirteen <s>Saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> (offenses requiring formal meeting) offenses have been recited; the two <s>Aniyata</s> (undetermined) offenses have been recited; the thirty <s>Niḥsargika Pātayantikā</s> (offenses requiring forfeiture and expiation) offenses have been recited; the ninety <s>Pātayantikā</s> (expiation) offenses have been recited; the four <s>Pratideśanīya</s> (confession) offenses have been recited; the numerous <s>Śaikṣa</s> (training) offenses have been recited; the seven <s>Adhikaraṇaśamatha</s> (means of settling disputes) offenses have been recited.

children.text: etāvat tasya bhagavataḥ sūtragataṃ sūtraparyāpannam (a)nvardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśam āg(acchati) iti yo (v)ā (pu)nar anyo 'p(y āga)cched dharmasyānudharmas tatra vaḥ sahitaiḥ samagraiḥ saṃmodamānair avivadamānair ekāgr(ai)r ekoddeśair ekakṣīrodakībhūtai(ḥ) sukhaṃ phā(ṣaṃ) v(iha)rtavyam iti śikṣā karaṇīyā //
children.translated_text: This much is contained in the <s>sūtra</s>, is comprised within the <s>sūtra</s>, and comes up for the recitation of the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> every half-month — and whatever else may also come up in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s>. In that regard, you must train to dwell in happiness and ease — united, harmonious, rejoicing together, not quarreling, of one mind, of one recitation, blended like milk and water.

children.text: II (Verse)
children.translated_text: II (Verse)

children.text: PrMoSū_Schluss_V.1:
children.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 1:

children.text:
kṣānti(ḥ) paramaṃ tapas titīkṣā
  nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhāḥ
  na hi pravrajita(ḥ pa)ropat(āp)ī
  (ś)ramaṇo bhavati parā(n) viheṭhayānaḥ 1
children.translated_text:
Patience is the supreme austerity, forbearance;
the <s>Buddhas</s> declare <s>Nirvāṇa</s> to be supreme.
For one gone forth who harms others
is no ascetic, one who injures others. 1

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.2:
  cakṣuṣmān viṣamānī(va) vidyamāne parākrame
  paṇḍito jīvaloke 'smi(n) pāpāni (parivarjayet 2)
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 2:
As one with eyes avoids uneven ground where danger exists,
so should the wise one in this world of the living avoid evils. 2

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.3:
  (nopavā)d(ī) nopaghātī prātimokṣe ca saṃvaraḥ
  mātrajñatā ca bhakteṣu prāntaṃ ca śayanāsanam
  adhicitte samāyoga etad buddhasya ś(āsa)nam 3
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 3:
Not reviling, not harming, and restraint in the <s>Prātimokṣa</s>;
moderation in food, and a secluded dwelling;
devoting oneself to the higher mind —
this is the teaching of the <s>Buddhas</s>. 3

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.4:
  yath(ā)pi bhramaraḥ puṣpād varṇagandhāv aheṭhayan
  paraiti rasam ādāya tathā grāmāṃ muniś caret 4
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 4:
Just as a bee, without harming the color or fragrance of a flower,
departs having taken the nectar, so should a sage move through villages. 4

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.5:
  na pareṣāṃ vilomāni na pareṣāṃ kṛtākṛtam
  ātmanas tu samīkṣeta samāni viṣamāni ca 5
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 5:
Not the faults of others, not what others have done or left undone,
but one's own [deeds] should one examine — what has been done rightly and what wrongly. 5

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.6:
  adhicet(a)s(i) mā p(ra)madyata pratataṃ maunapadeṣu śikṣata
  śokā na bhavanti tāyino hy upaśāntasya sadā smṛtātmanaḥ 6
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 6:
Be not heedless in the higher mind; train constantly in the precepts of the silent sage.
Sorrows do not arise for one who is a protector, ever at peace, with mindful self. 6

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.7:
  sarvapāpasyākaraṇaṃ kuśalasyopasaṃpadaḥ
  svacittaparyavadanam etad buddhasya śāsanaṃ 7
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 7:
The non-doing of all evil, the accomplishment of good,
the purification of one's own mind —
this is the teaching of the <s>Buddhas</s>. 7

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.8:
  kāyena saṃvaraḥ sādhu sādhu vācā ca saṃvaraḥ
  manasā saṃvaraḥ sādhu sādhu sarvatra saṃvaraḥ
  sarvatra saṃvṛto bhikṣu(ḥ) sarvaduḥkhāt pramucyate 8
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 8:
Good is restraint of body; good is restraint of speech;
good is restraint of mind; good is restraint everywhere.
The <s>bhikṣu</s> restrained everywhere is freed from all suffering. 8

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.9:
  vācānurakṣī manasā susaṃvṛtaḥ
  kāyena caivākuśalaṃ na kuryāt
  etāṃ śubhāṃ karmapathāṃ viśodhaya(nn)
  ā(rādhay)en (mārga)m ṛṣipraveditam 9
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 9:
Guarding one's speech, well-restrained in mind,
one should not do what is unwholesome with the body.
Purifying these three paths of action,
one would attain the path proclaimed by the sages. 9

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.10:
  kṣiptaḥ kṣipen naiva hato na hanyād
  vairaprasaṃgeṣu bhaved avair(aḥ
  duṣṭe)ṣu ca syāt satataṃ prasanna(ḥ)
  (s)v(a)y(aṃ) na kuryāt paragarhitaṃ yat 10
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 10:
When provoked, one should not provoke in return; when struck, one should not strike back.
In occasions of enmity, one should be without enmity;
among the hostile, one should ever be tranquil;
one should not do what others would condemn. 10

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.11:
  saptabhir lokanāyakair buddhavīrair mahātmabhiḥ
  prātimokṣaḥ samuddiṣṭo nirdiṣṭaś ca maharṣiṇā 11
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 11:
By the seven Leaders of the World, the heroic <s>Buddhas</s>, the great-souled ones,
the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> has been recited and was proclaimed by the Great Sage. 11

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.12:
  atra sagauravā buddhā buddhānāṃ śrāvakāś ca ye
  atra sagauravā bhūtvā tathānyonyasagauravā
  hrīravatrāpyasaṃpannā(ḥ) prāpnuvanti hy asaṃskṛtam 12
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 12:
Herein the <s>Buddhas</s> are reverential, and those who are disciples of the <s>Buddhas</s>;
having become reverential herein, and likewise reverential toward one another,
endowed with a sense of shame and moral dread, they attain the unconditioned (<s>asaṃskṛta</s>). 12

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.13:
  ārabhadhvaṃ niṣkramadhvaṃ yujyadhvaṃ buddhaśāsane /
  dhunadhvaṃ mṛtyunaḥ sainyaṃ naḍāgāram iva kuñjaraḥ 13
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 13:
Strive forth! Go forth! Exert yourselves in the teaching of the <s>Buddha</s>!
Shatter the army of Death, as an elephant [shatters] a reed hut. 13

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.14:
  yo hy asmiṃ dharmavinaye apramatto bhaviṣyati
  prahāya jātisaṃsāraṃ duḥkhasyāntaṃ sa (y)āsyati 14
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 14:
Whoever shall be heedful in this <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>,
having abandoned the cycle of birth and <s>saṃsāra</s>, shall reach the end of suffering. 14

children.text:
PrMoSū_Schluss_V.15:
  yasyārth(e) sūtram uddiṣṭaṃ yasyārthe poṣathaḥ kṛtaḥ
  tac chīlam anurakṣadhvaṃ vālāgra(ṃ) ca(ma)ro yathā 15
children.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>, Concluding Verse 15:
For whose sake the <s>sūtra</s> was recited, for whose sake the <s>poṣatha</s> (observance) was performed —
guard that morality, as the <s>camara</s> deer [guards] the tip of its tail-hair. 15

children.text: uddiṣṭa(ḥ) prātimokṣaḥ kṛtaḥ samagreṇa saṃghena poṣatha iti //
children.translated_text: The <s>Prātimokṣa</s> has been recited. The <s>poṣatha</s> (observance) has been performed by the united <s>Saṅgha</s>.

children.text: prātimokṣasūtraṃ samāpta(m) //
children.translated_text: The <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> is concluded.
